findings.label: Plan deviation: merge path instead of index run
findings.detail: Coder used targeted embed-and-merge rather than create_index/evaluate because validate() rejects pre-existing route-bearing POIs. Disclosed in the gap doc and independently verified honest: re-embedding two new PNGs through prepare_dataset.image_embedding reproduced the stored vectors exactly (max|delta|=0, cos=1.0). No action required.
